The Shaan-Gan-Ning Border Region's area and end, the other base areas (Jin-Sui, Jin-Cha-Ji, Ji-Lu-Yu) 1938-1945, the 19 base areas of 1945, Zhangjiakou 1946, Shijiazhuang 1947, the recapture of Yan'an, Shanghai, Hangzhou, Wuhan and Xinjiang in 1949, the leadership seat 1947-1949
1945-1946 outlines are Cliopatria's 1947 shape as a proxy; Yan'an and Suide are not in the gazetteer

Northern Shaanxi Soviet (Liu Zhidan, Gao Gang, Xu Haidong)

problems: No dossier of this batch existed before the run and no earlier report or notes file was found, so all three were written fresh; none was kept from an earlier run.
Cliopatria's Communist Party of China 1938-1945 shape is 96% Xinjiang (Cliopatria error); the dossier removes Xinjiang and keeps the Yan'an region.

Mirror events missing in republic-of-china (ea-08-c): gain from anti-kuomintang-coalition in November 1930, loss of Beijing to Zhang Xueliang in September 1930, Jinan gain and loss in 1930; Luoyang (April 1948) and Taiyuan (April 1949) from communist-party-of-china; the PRC gains of Guangzhou, Chongqing and Chengdu (October-December 1949) are covered there only by one loss event of October 1949.

Mirror events for people-s-republic-of-china that other dossiers already hold but the PRC lacks for the page budget: islamic-republic-of-pakistan 1963 loss, socialist-republic-of-vietnam 1979 and 1999, kazakhstan 2002, kyrgyzstan 2009, republic-of-tajikistan 2011.

The Chinese Civil War page is cited by both communist-party-of-china and people-s-republic-of-china (opened once in this run); 11 distinct pages were opened in all, 12 source entries across the three dossiers.
Several WebFetch answers were summaries of long pages; where a sentence came back unquoted the dossiers paraphrase it ('closely paraphrased') instead of quoting.
The Wikipedia field of the three rows is as Cliopatria gives it ('Central Plains War', 'Chinese Communist Party', 'China'); Q717809 is the war's item, not the coalition's.

Types: anti-kuomintang-coalition and communist-party-of-china are type rebel (the second runs 1931-1949, hatched until 1 October 1949); the dossier of the first has no ruler strip and the second has none because the pages give no complete list.
